newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks still sharply lower, bonds fall.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks still sharply lower, bonds fall.

text.p: U.S. stocks remained slumped in negative ground on Friday, battered by profit-taking and sharp declines in bonds after strong July employment and National Association of Purchasing Management data.

The Dow Jones Industrial average was down 102 points, over one percent, at 8121, while the long bond extended losses. The benchmark U.S. Treasury stumbled two full points, then traded off 1-19/32 at a 6.44 percent yield.
The Nasdaq composite index was down seven points at 1588.
